title: 'Broken system' of property tax appeals put extra $2 billion on Cook County homeowners, treasurer says

statements.summary: Rejects the claim that the Board of Review's business reductions shifted the tax burden onto homeowners, blaming inaccurate initial assessments instead.
statements.quote: “It isn’t the Board of Review, it’s the system,” Cardenas said Saturday. “It’s the perfect storm. ... People should be appealing more.”

statements.summary: Says the property tax system is stacked against homeowners and names circuit breakers as the solution.
statements.quote: “The system is stacked against the homeowner,” Cardenas said. “Circuit breakers are a solution.”
